handoffs.message: APP-001 deliverables ready for Codex review. Three artifacts created in services/control-plane/bff/: (1) BFF_API_CONTRACT.md — formal v1 API contract with 33 read-only surfaces, RBAC matrix, error/staleness models, composed views, SSE real-time feeds, secondary control path; (2) CONSULTATION_SURFACE_CONTRACT.md — 6 consultation surfaces citing canonical SessionPersona/ConsultPolicy objects with no shadow model; (3) DEGRADED_OPERATOR_PATH.md — full degradation matrix, admin CLI requirements, operator journeys under failure. All acceptance criteria met. Ready for review.
APP-001 approved. Formal BFF, consultation, and degraded-path contracts are aligned; owner should finalize to done.
